```python
PARAMS = {
    "R_sk":   (66.3e3, 45e3, 100e3),     # SK resistors R1=R2 [ohm]
    "C2":     (0.8e-12, 0.5e-12, 1.2e-12),  # SK ground cap [F]
    "C1r":    (4.0, 3.0, 5.0),           # C1/C2 ratio (Q = sqrt(C1r)/2)
    "kp":     (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),           # real-pole freq / biquad w0
    "C3":     (3.0e-12, 1.5e-12, 6e-12), # output-pole cap (CL adds to it) [F]
    "Itail":  (20e-6, 12e-6, 24e-6),     # set by mirror ratio to IREF
    "I2":     (35e-6, 20e-6, 40e-6),     # 2nd-stage current via mirror ratio
    "W_in":   (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),         # diff pair width, L=0.5
    "Cc":     (1.2e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "Rz":     (6e3, 2e3, 12e3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")

    # bias: IREF into diode nfet, L=1
    Lb = 1.0
    Wref = 2.3 * iref / 10e-6
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, Lb)
    Wt = Wref * p["Itail"] / iref
    W6 = Wref * p["I2"] / iref
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lb)

    # op-amp stage 1: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load
    Lin = 0.5
    n.M("M1", "d1", "opout", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], Lin)
    n.M("M2", "d2", "x2", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], Lin)
    Lp = 0.5
    Wld = 4.0 * (p["Itail"] / 2) / 10e-6
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "d2", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wld, Lp)

    # stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS sink, Miller comp with nulling R
    W5 = Wld * p["I2"] / (p["Itail"] / 2)
    n.M("M5", "opout", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W5, Lp)
    n.M("M6", "opout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, Lb)
    n.R("RZ", "d2", "cz", p["Rz"])
    n.C("CC", "cz", "opout", p["Cc"])

    # unity-gain Sallen-Key biquad
    R = p["R_sk"]; C2 = p["C2"]; C1 = p["C1r"] * C2
    n.R("R1", "vin", "x1", R)
    n.R("R2", "x1", "x2", R)
    n.C("C1", "x1", "opout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "x2", "vss", C2)

    # passive output pole (absorbs CL)
    w0 = 1.0 / (R * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))
    Q = math.sqrt(C1 / C2) / 2.0
    wp = p["kp"] * w0
    Ctot = p["C3"] + cl
    R3 = 1.0 / (wp * Ctot)
    n.R("R3", "opout", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", p["C3"])

    # predictions (ideal transfer function)
    f = np.logspace(3, 9, 6000)
    s = 1j * 2 * PI * f
    H = 1.0 / (1 + s / wp) / (1 + s / (w0 * Q) + (s / w0) ** 2)
    mag = 20 * np.log10(np.abs(H))
    g0 = mag[0]
    peaking = max(0.0, float(np.max(mag) - g0))
    idx = int(np.argmax(mag < g0 - 3.0))
    fc = float(f[idx])
    sf = 10 * fc
    ss = 1j * 2 * PI * sf
    Hs = 1.0 / (1 + ss / wp) / (1 + ss / (w0 * Q) + (ss / w0) ** 2)
    atten = float(g0 - 20 * np.log10(abs(Hs)))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + p["Itail"] + p["I2"])
    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": peaking,
               "power": power, "gain_db": -0.05}
```
